steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setSceneReady?.(true); })()

steps.name: enter-room
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const rooms=s.floorPlan.rooms; const room=rooms.find(r=>/living/i.test(r.name))||rooms[0]; s.selectRoom(room.id); s.enterRoomEditor(room.id); s.hideLoading?.(); return room.name; })()

steps.name: select-wall-tab
steps.eval: (() => { const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.finish-surface-tabs button')]; const wall=tabs.find(b=>/wall/i.test(b.textContent||'')); if(wall) wall.click(); return tabs.map(t=>t.textContent); })()

steps.name: open-paint-viz
steps.eval: (() => { const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; const b=btns.find(x=>/try on my wall photo/i.test(x.textContent||'')); if(b){b.click(); return 'clicked';} return 'not-found'; })()

steps.name: inject-photo
steps.eval: (() => { const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=680; cv.height=460; const c=cv.getContext('2d'); const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,460); g.addColorStop(0,'#efe9df'); g.addColorStop(1,'#c9bfae'); c.fillStyle=g; c.fillRect(0,0,680,460); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.06)'; for(let y=0;y<460;y+=6){ c.fillRect(0,y,680,2); } c.fillStyle='#6b7686'; c.fillRect(430,90,200,170); c.fillStyle='#aeb9c7'; c.fillRect(438,98,184,154); c.strokeStyle='#3d4652'; c.lineWidth=6; c.strokeRect(430,90,200,170); c.fillStyle='#8a7a5f'; c.fillRect(0,410,680,50); cv.toBlob((blob)=>{ const file=new File([blob],'wall.png',{type:'image/png'}); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); const input=document.querySelector('.paint-viz input[type=file]'); input.files=dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }, 'image/png'); return 'injecting'; })()

steps.name: place-polygon
steps.eval: (() => { const cv=document.querySelector('.paint-viz-canvas'); const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const pts=[[0.04,0.05],[0.58,0.05],[0.58,0.86],[0.04,0.86]]; for(const [fx,fy] of pts){ const x=r.left+fx*r.width; const y=r.top+fy*r.height; cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true,pointerId:1})); } return 'placed-'+pts.length; })()

steps.name: apply-first-swatch
steps.eval: (() => { const sw=[...document.querySelectorAll('.paint-viz-swatch')]; const target=sw.find(s=>/blue|navy|indigo|teal/i.test(s.textContent||''))||sw[Math.min(6,sw.length-1)]; if(target){target.click(); return target.textContent;} return 'no-swatch'; })()

steps.name: apply-second-swatch
steps.eval: (() => { const sw=[...document.querySelectorAll('.paint-viz-swatch')]; const target=sw.find(s=>/green|sage|olive|forest/i.test(s.textContent||''))||sw.find(s=>/terra|clay|rust|red|brick|coral/i.test(s.textContent||''))||sw[Math.min(2,sw.length-1)]; if(target){target.click(); return target.textContent;} return 'no-swatch'; })()

steps.name: lower-coverage
steps.eval: (() => { const sl=document.querySelector('.paint-viz-strength .slider'); if(sl){ const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(sl,'0.45'); sl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'coverage-0.45'; } return 'no-slider'; })()
